Data.subject: Energy and Utilities
Data.title: Total Final Energy Consumption By Energy Type And Sector, Annual
Data.datasource: ENERGY MARKET AUTHORITY, ENTERPRISE SINGAPORE, NATIONAL ENVIRONMENT AGENCY AND SINGAPORE DEPARTMENT OF STATISTICS

row.footnote: In accordance with the Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2020 (SSIC 2020), Industrial-related consumption comprises consumption of Agriculture and Fishing (SSIC Section A, Division 1-3), Mining and Quarrying (SSIC Section B, Division 8-9), Manufacturing (SSIC Section C, Division 10-32), Utilities (SSIC Section D, Division 35, and Section E, Division 36-38) and Construction (SSIC Section F, Division 41-43).

In accordance with the Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2020 (SSIC 2020), Commerce & Services-related consumption comprises consumption of Wholesale and Retail Trade (SSIC Section G, Division 46-47), Accommodation and Food Services Activities (SSIC Section I, Division 55 - 56), Information and Communications (SSIC Section J, Division 58-63), Financial and Insurance Activities (SSIC Section K, Division 64-66), Real Estate Activities (SSIC Section L, Division 68), Professional, Scientific and Technical Activities (SSIC Section M, Division 69-75), Administrative and Support Services Activities (SSIC Section N, Division 77-82), Public Administration and Defence (SSIC Section O, Division 84), Education (SSIC Section P, Division 85), Health and Social Services (SSIC Section Q, Division 86-88).  Arts, Entertainment and Recreation (SSIC Section R, Division 90-93), Other Service Activities (SSIC Section S, Division 94-96), Activities of Households as Employers of Domestic Personnel (SSIC Section T, Division 97) and Activities of Extra-Territorial Organisations and Bodies (SSIC Section U, Division 99).

In accordance with the Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2020 (SSIC 2020), Transport-related consumption comprises consumption of Land Transport (SSIC Division 49), Water Transport (SSIC Division 50), Air Transport (SSIC Division 51), Warehousing and Support Activities for Transportation (SSIC Division 52), and Postal and Courier Activities (SSIC Division 53).
The scope of the Households sector includes all households in their capacity as final consumers.
Refer to sectors or activities not adequately defined in the Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2020 (SSIC 2020).

Coal and Peat products include all coals, both primary (including Hard Coal and Lignite/Brown Coal) and derived fuels (including Patent Fuel, Coke over Coke, Gas Coke, BKB, Coke Oven Gas, Blast Furnace Gas and Oxygen Steel Furnace Gas).  Peat is also included in this category.
